Flitch is rough cut wood that has only been coarsely ripped into planks at the [[circular saw]] or [[sawhorse]].  Additionally, it can be obtained by salvaging broken furniture in the [[dungeon]].  It is used to construct a wide variety of the [[Work Stations]] in the game.
